brief.label: Competitors and the pages to watch

deliver_to.label: Where to send the brief (your Slack or Telegram channel)

steps.title: Write the watch list
steps.prompt:
From this brief: {{inputs.brief}}

Write {{run.dir}}/watch.json: each competitor with the URLs of its pricing, product, changelog and ad library pages. If {{project.path}}/.troop/competitor-watch/watch.json exists, start from it and keep its URLs.

steps.title: Snapshot every page
steps.prompt: Fetch every URL in {{run.dir}}/watch.json and save each as markdown in {{run.dir}}/snapshots/, one file per URL named after it. List every page that failed to fetch under failed.

steps.title: Diff against last time
steps.prompt: Compare each file in {{run.dir}}/snapshots/ with the file of the same name in {{project.path}}/.troop/competitor-watch/last/. Ignore layout-only changes. Write {{run.dir}}/changes.md: each change with page, before and after. Then copy {{run.dir}}/snapshots/ over {{project.path}}/.troop/competitor-watch/last/ and {{run.dir}}/watch.json to {{project.path}}/.troop/competitor-watch/watch.json for next time.

steps.title: Keep the signals
steps.prompt: Keep the changes in {{run.dir}}/changes.md that match these rules: {{inputs.rules}}. Drop the rest. Write {{run.dir}}/signals.json as a list of items with id, title (competitor and change), preview (before and after), reason (the rule it matched) and status pending. Set the output key items to that path.

steps.title: Write the brief
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/brief.md from {{run.dir}}/signals.json: one line per signal with what changed, the page link, and what it means for us. End with the pages that failed to fetch: {{steps.snapshot.outputs.failed}}. Set document to the brief path.

steps.title: Approve sending
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/brief.md. Approve to send it to {{inputs.deliver_to}}.

steps.title: Send the brief
steps.prompt: Post the text of {{run.dir}}/brief.md to {{inputs.deliver_to}} as one message. Send nothing else. Set sent to true once it is delivered.
